title: The Choice of Fate
text: “I see, so you’re leaving already.”
Ren seemed rather regretful about Ark’s departure, I noted. He’d been enjoying some fairly intense sword clashes with him nearly every morning, after all.
“Yeah.”
“…I can’t ask you directly here, but could we talk a little later?”
“Sure. A secret talk?”
“Something like that.”
It seemed Ren had something he wanted to ask Ark without the others overhearing.

And so, with tomorrow being the day of departure, everyone spent the time speaking individually with Ark and Hou-kun. Eventually, once the sun had set and everyone had drifted off to sleep, I put the Filolial-samas to bed and headed toward where Ark and the others were. There, gazing up at the night sky, I found Older Sister, Ark, and Hou-kun together. Ren passed me on the way, apparently having already finished his talk.
“――You’ll come to know the answer to that question eventually. It wouldn’t be an interesting answer even if you knew it now.”
“Ohh, dodging the question, are we?”
They seemed to be keeping each other company over drinks.

“Who knows. I think it’d be best for you to spend this peaceful life of yours as it is now. Try not to be too overprotective a guardian toward Naofumi-kun and Raphtalia-chan. If you collapse, it’s the two of them who’ll grieve.”
“Ohh.”
Big Sister continued sipping her drink, glug, glug.
“So you’ll be leaving tomorrow, huh.”
“Yeah.”
“Thinking that this’ll be the last time we drink together makes me a little wistful.”
Hou-kun said this while drinking the impressively strong liquor Older Sister kept recommending.
“Well then, Big Sister’s off to go see Naofumi-chan and the others.”
“Yeah. Off you go~”
Eventually Older Sister rose and walked off toward Father’s house.
“…A brief slumber.”

Ark murmured this quietly as he watched Older Sister go. And then… what should I do, I wondered? While I agonized over whether to call out to them… none other than Filo-tan came wandering up! Filo-tan, I say! Since I hadn’t been able to see her much lately, should I leap out and greet her? Just as I thought this, the inscription I’d read the day before yesterday flashed through my mind. Calm yourself, Motoyasu—this was surely a revelation telling me to endure just a little longer. I mustn’t leap out here. It had been written that I must intervene at the moment Filo-tan was seeking counsel. Otherwise, the misfortune awaiting Filo-tan, the Filolial-samas, and Father could not be averted. What could this unavoidable sorrow possibly be? If the prophecy offered some means of avoiding it, I was willing to play along, at least a little.
“Good evening~ Filo’s name is Filo.”
“Ah, Filo-chan. What brings you out at this hour?”
“Um, the cat person and the great bird person are leaving tomorrow, right? So Filo came because there’s something she wanted to ask.”
“Ahh, everyone’s giving us such a warm send-off, asking all sorts of things—it’s almost too comfortable, isn’t it?”
Hou-kun made a witty little joke here.
“Was Filo not supposed to ask?”
“No, it’s fine. So, Filo-chan. What is it you want to ask us?”
Whoosh… the night wind blew past Filo-tan, me, and Hou-kun. But strangely, Ark didn’t seem to feel the wind at all, quietly waiting for Filo-tan’s question.
“Um, well—I don’t want you to think it’s weird, okay?”
“Sure.”
With very gentle eyes, Ark seemed prepared to listen slowly and carefully to whatever Filo-tan wanted to convey.
“Like, sometimes the cat person has the same eyes as Master.”
“Is that so?”
“Yeah. With everyone else it’s different, but somehow the cat person’s the same.”
“I see.”
“Yeah… um, so—”
Filo-tan seemed to choose her words carefully, showing a bit of hesitation as she asked, almost pleading.
“The cat person and the great bird person are amazing, right?”
“I don’t think I’m that amazing…”
“I think I’m amazing.”
Ark shot Hou-kun a look that said “read the room.”
“Um, see, when Filo asks Master or Raphtalia-onee-chan, they say don’t worry about it and won’t let Filo join in at all. So Filo wants the cat person to tell her.”
“What is it you want to know?”

From Filo-tan’s words, I too understood, if only vaguely, that this had to do with whatever was going on with Father and the others. Not yet… I mustn’t intervene yet. Yes, something in my mind was whispering to wait for the right timing. A choice, I suppose you could call it, within my own head.
“Filo—sometimes Master and Raphtalia-onee-chan and everyone stare off into the distance. Filo wants to look at the same place too. So, hey, how can Filo get to that same place?”

That question struck a chord in me as well. Yes—Father and Big Sister had been gazing off into the distance ever since defeating the Crimson Swine’s true body. As though they’d promised to pay some great price in exchange for defeating it, and were now doing something toward that end…
“Hmm… that’s quite difficult. Are you prepared—resolved never to look back? No matter how many partings come, could you bear them without regret?”
“Eh? Yeah! Filo will do her best!”
“Even if that resolve means parting with a friend you love dearly?”
“Eh? Mel-chan? Filo won’t be able to see Mel-chan anymore?”
“Not right away. But even if it eventually comes to that, could you wait for Naofumi-kun and Raphtalia-chan?”
“Ugh… Filo doesn’t know!”
Intervene in Filo-tan’s consultation. ← Pretend you heard nothing and go home as is.
Tick, tick… the choices displayed themselves in my mind. Choose, my fate seemed to be telling me.
“But Filo will do her best!”
Motoyasu, the time limit on your choice is closing in. You must choose quickly. The choices crackled and burned in my mind, hurrying me along. Argh! Fine, I’ll do it, I say!
“Filo-taaan!”
“Eek! Spear Guy’s voice!? Nooo!?”
The moment I raised my voice and leapt into the scene where Filo-tan, Ark, and Hou-kun stood, Filo-tan turned her back and bolted.
“Wha—Motoyasu-kun!?”
“Oh my, this is a surprise.”
“Bird, go bring Filo-chan back.”
“Yes, yes.”
Hou-kun flew off chasing after the fleeing Filo-tan. He caught up with her almost immediately and seemed to be talking with her about something.
“So, Motoyasu-kun. What brings you here? Perhaps an early farewell greeting?”
Ask Ark. ← Chase after Filo-tan.
As I watched Ark’s smiling face, yet another choice appeared in my mind. As for me, I wanted nothing more than to play with Filo-tan a bit more, but there was something I had to ask.
“That’s not it, indeed. Rather than playing with Filo-tan, there’s something I want to ask right now.”
“What is it?”
Thump… As Ark tilted his head slightly in that gesture, I found myself overlapping his image with Father’s.
“Why…”
“Hm?”
Just for this one moment, I set aside Filo-tan, and thoughts of Father—whom I could never see again—passed through my mind. The Fathers I’d met each time I looped flickered past in memory.
“Why do you overlap with Father so much?”
It almost felt as though Ark were one of those Fathers, having crossed worlds to see me, quietly waiting for me to notice.
At my question, Ark’s eyes widened greatly before a faint smile spread across his face.
“Now that’s quite an interesting thing to say. Do I really resemble Naofumi-kun that much?”
As if offering a rebuttal, Ark spread both arms wide and asked.
